public_rationale: He wrote that despite hundreds of billions of GPUs sold, 'nobody seems to make any money', other than NVIDIA and resellers like Dell and Supermicro. The word 'seems' makes this an impression, not a firm statement. He names no measure of making money, such as revenue, operating profit or net profit. He also does not say who counts as 'nobody': GPU operators, cloud firms or the wider supply chain. Scoring it would mean choosing a measure and a set of companies he did not name. The contract therefore does not score it, and no outcome evidence is cited.
limitations: No outcome evidence is cited, so this case does not show whether any particular company made or lost money on GPUs.
The case does not test a firmer version of the claim with a named measure and scope.
